title: MHFW Releases 'Anemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan' Guidelines Expanding to 7x7x7 Framework
summary: Adds Low Birth Weight babies and Eating Right to transition from T3 to T4 approach.

blocks.content: Adds Low Birth Weight babies and Eating Right to transition from T3 to T4 approach.

items: 7x7x7 Expansion: Expands 6x6x6 to 7x7x7 by adding LBW babies (0-6 months), 'Eating Right' intervention, and M&E framework.
T4 Approach: Transitions from Test, Treat, Talk to Test, Treat, Talk & Track.
IV Iron Therapy: Includes Intravenous Iron Therapy (Ferric Carboxymaltose) for severe anemia in pregnant women.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: NFHS-5 data shows 67.1% of children (6-59 months) and 57% of women in India are anemic.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: New beneficiary group (LBW babies 0-6 months) vs T4 approach (adds 'Track').
